summary: Checked the Node.js version fix for the Vercel build. Every Vercel-related file now says Node 24: root package.json and frontend/package.json have engines.node '24.x', vercel.json is valid JSON and its functions block holds only maxDuration (no '@vercel/node@3.2.0' runtime pin), the GitHub workflow uses node-version '24' and .deployment-config has NODE_VERSION=24. No .nvmrc or .node-version files exist. Ran the vercel.json install and build commands locally with Node v24.19.0 and yarn 1.22.22. Root 'yarn install --frozen-lockfile' exited 0. Frontend 'yarn install --frozen-lockfile' exited 0. 'yarn build' exited 0 in about 12s and created frontend/dist with index.html and assets. No engine-compatibility errors. Root 'npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json' exited 0. Preview landing page smoke check passed: landing-page, hero-section and pricing-section each render once, and the page displays correctly.
action_items: LOW: frontend/yarn.lock is untracked in git and frontend/bun.lockb is the tracked lockfile. Make sure yarn.lock gets committed. Without it, Vercel's 'yarn install --frozen-lockfile' still works (yarn 1 does not fail when there is no lockfile), but installs are not reproducible. The root also has no yarn.lock, only a stale package-lock.json.
LOW (does not affect Vercel): buildspec.yml and buildspec-fullstack.yml still pin nodejs: 20 for AWS CodeBuild, and netlify.toml has NODE_VERSION=22. Update these if those pipelines are still used.
critical_code_review_comments: Root devDependency @types/node ^25.9.1 while the runtime is Node 24. This is harmless because tsc passes, but '^24' would match the runtime.
vercel.json build.env and env contain public keys only (Supabase publishable key, Razorpay test key id). No secret keys found.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Node is pinned to 24.x across the Vercel config. Verify with: root yarn install --frozen-lockfile; cd frontend && yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn build; npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json. Landing smoke check: set localStorage hasSeenVisitorAuth=true.
